items.quote: OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user, providing secure and limited access to their account without requiring their credentials.
items.why: Quote covers only OAuth2 tokens; bearer_token and api_key not mentioned.

items.quote: PATs are tokens with a custom expiry that you manually generate to access the Management API.
items.why: States PATs are manual, custom-expiry Management API tokens; no api_key or OAuth2 coverage.

items.quote: Start building for free, collaborate with your team, then scale to millions of users
items.why: Generic free-start marketing; no mention of PAT or OAuth app registration or self-serve access.

items.quote: Manage your Supabase organizations and projects programmatically.
items.why: Says Management API covers orgs and projects; no REST or GraphQL, no breadth detail.

items.quote: Connect your AI tools to Supabase using MCP
items.why: Implies a Supabase MCP for AI tools; URL and vendor-official status not in quote.
